title: Starting Web Apps While Stuck in Barton Hall, Sleeping in the Closet, & The Chickenshit Report
description: Remaining stuck on Level 2 in Barton Hall because moving to Cantor Hall requires earning Level 3, Katie and Nate start the Web Applications Developer course using personal laptops alongside middle-aged classmates Tina, Jim, and Sheila, shut down front-desk staffer Mr. Vance with signed yellow Hall Passes, survive a violent afternoon in the therapeutic pool, sneak into a rarely used back seasonal-storage closet where they are found after the 11:00 PM curfew check, get falsely accused of sneaking off to have sex, call the night supervisor's expulsion bluff by telling him to call their dad in Alexandria right now, and confront the duty supervisor over the morning 'Chickenshit Report.'
